newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KAUBAMAJA APPLIES TO MOVE TO MAIN LIST.
newsitem.headline: KAUBAMAJA APPLIES TO MOVE TO MAIN LIST.

text.p: Tallinna Kaubamaja has applied to move from the free market to the main list of the Tallinn stock exchange and its application will be reviewed on August 12, the stock exchange said on Monday.

"The listing commission meeting will be held tomorrow in the afternoon and it will be considering an application from Tallinn Department Store," Helo Meigas, managing director of the bourse, told Reuters.
"It has applied to move from the free market and be traded on the main list of the exchange," she added.
